title: The Tin in the Pit
lines: Pam and Tim sit. It is a map!
A pit is in the map!
Tap at it, Tim. Tap, tap.
Pam and Tim sit at the pit.
A tin is in the pit. Tip it!
A tin man is in it!
Pam and Tim pat the tin man.

questions.ask: What did Pam and Tim see drawn on the map?
questions.listenFor: A pit. Line two says it. Tapping at it, in line three, is them pointing at the spot.
A tin man. Line six says it. Let them read that line back rather than being told.

questions.ask: If you dug up a tin, what would you want to find in it? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Anything at all. You are listening for an idea of their own, not a right answer.
